cod_assessment.drift_risk_rationale: Construction started Nov 2025 — ~25 months to reported COD 2027-11-30. Pace is fast but feasible for a developer (SE Juno) with prior experience at this site. Key risk: FIS not yet approved; Buck Canyon 345kV substation under construction — if substation slips, interconnection delays cascade. Positive: NTP already issued, developer track record at site, 500 MW with bifacial trackers follows established layout.
